recipes.title: Potato and Aubergine Curry
recipes.description: Baked aubergine and potato simmered in garam masala, tomato and coconut milk.

steps.instructionText: Heat the oven to 200 °C (392 °F).
Cut the aubergine into 1 cm slices and lay them on a tray. Coat with some of the olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
Cook the onions in the rest of the oil over medium heat for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, garam masala, turmeric and ground coriander and stir for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the chopped tomatoes and coconut milk, then the baked aubergine and the potatoes cut into chunks.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, boil the rice.
Uncover and cook for 5 more minutes, until the sauce reduces. Serve with the rice.

recipes.title: Coriander Chicken
recipes.description: Boneless chicken marinated in a green coriander, yoghurt and chilli paste, cooked with whole spices.

steps.instructionText: Cut the chicken into small bite-sized pieces.
Blend the coriander leaves, green chillies, yoghurt, ginger, garlic and onions into a smooth paste.
Mix half of the paste into the chicken with the garam masala and a little salt.
Leave the chicken to marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oil in a frying pan. Add the sugar and cook until it melts into the oil.
Add the cardamom pods, cinnamon stick and bay leaf and cook for 1 minute, then lower the heat to medium.
Add the marinated chicken and cook, stirring so it doesn't stick, until the oil starts to separate.
Add the rest of the paste and stir until thick. Season with salt and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Lamb Biryani
recipes.description: Tamil-style one-pot biryani: lamb simmered with whole spices, then basmati rice cooked in the same pot.

steps.instructionText: Wash the basmati rice until the water runs clear, then soak it for 30 minutes.
Dice the tomatoes and slice the onions thinly. Grind the ginger and garlic to a paste. Slit the green chilli lengthways.
Heat the oil in a big pot over medium heat and toast the cardamom, bay leaves, cinnamon and cloves for 30 seconds.
Add the onions and sauté for 3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and the ginger-garlic paste and sauté for 3 more minutes.
Add the lamb, 500 ml water, the green chilli, turmeric, curry powder, chilli powder and salt. Cook on high heat for 50 minutes, adding water if needed.
Add enough water to make about 800 ml of liquid in the pot and bring it back to the boil.
Drain the rice and add it to the pot with the garam masala and lemon juice.
When most of the water has been absorbed, turn the heat to its lowest and adjust the salt and spice.
Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Garnish with mint or coriander and serve with raita.

recipes.title: Homemade Yogurt (Dahi)
recipes.description: Set your own thick yogurt from milk and a spoonful of starter, kept warm in flasks overnight.

steps.instructionText: Heat the milk to 45 °C (113 °F).
Whisk the yogurt into the milk.
Bring the milk back to 45 °C. Don't let it get hotter.
Rinse two 500 ml thermos flasks with about 100 ml of just-boiled water, then pour the water out.
Pour the milk into the flasks.
Leave them somewhere without draughts, such as a switched-off oven, for 12 hours.
Refrigerate the yogurt once it has set.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt (Hung Curd)
recipes.description: Homemade yogurt strained in cheesecloth until thick and creamy.

steps.instructionText: Heat the milk to 45 °C (113 °F), whisk in the yogurt and bring it back to 45 °C. Don't let it get hotter.
Rinse two 500 ml thermos flasks with about 100 ml of just-boiled water, then pour the water out.
Pour the milk into the flasks and leave them somewhere without draughts, such as a switched-off oven, for 12 hours.
Pour the set yogurt into a cheesecloth.
Hang the cheesecloth for 30 minutes to 4 hours: the longer it hangs, the thicker the yogurt.
Refrigerate the yogurt.

recipes.title: Tomato and Red Pepper Soup
recipes.description: Grilled red peppers and fresh tomatoes blended into a lightly spiced soup with a swirl of cream.

steps.instructionText: Halve and deseed the red peppers, then grill them in the oven or on a grill. Peel off the skins.
Peel and quarter the tomatoes.
Sauté the chopped onions and crushed garlic in the olive oil in a large soup pan until soft.
Add the stock, tomatoes and peppers and purée with a stick blender.
Stir in the cayenne pepper, paprika powder, herbs, oregano, ginger syrup and cream. Heat through and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Paprikash
recipes.description: Hungarian chicken thighs braised in a rich paprika and tomato sauce, finished with sour cream.

steps.instructionText: Pat the chicken thighs dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper.
Heat a little olive oil in a heavy, deep pan over high heat.
Brown the chicken skin-side down for 5 minutes on each side, then set aside.
Fry the onions in the chicken fat until golden.
Add the garlic powder and tomato paste and stir for 5 minutes.
Add the paprika and stir for 1 more minute.
Pour in the broth and heat until it is just bubbling.
Turn the heat to medium-low, return the chicken and its juices to the pan, cover and simmer for 60 minutes.
Check the chicken is tender, then season with salt and pepper.
Stir the sour cream into the sauce, dust with cayenne and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Red Bean Buns (Dou Sha Bao)
recipes.description: Soft, fluffy steamed buns filled with sweet homemade adzuki bean paste.

ingredients.name: adzuki red beans, soaked for 24 hours

steps.instructionText: Boil the soaked adzuki beans for 5 minutes, then drain and rinse.
Simmer the beans in fresh water for 2 hours, until easily squashed. Drain and blend to a smooth paste.
Cook the bean paste in a pan over low heat with 150 g of the sugar and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes, stirring, until dry. Cool.
In a bowl, mix the flour, the rest of the sugar, a pinch of salt, the baking powder and yeast with the water to make a dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes, then add the oil and knead 2 minutes more.
Cover the dough and leave it to rise for 1 hour.
Roll the bean paste into 6 balls. Knock the air out of the dough and divide it into 6 pieces.
Roll each piece into a 10-12 cm disc, put a ball of bean paste in the middle and pleat the edges to seal.
Set the buns on squares of baking paper in a covered steamer basket and rest for 10 minutes.
Steam for 20 minutes, then leave covered for 5 minutes before opening.

recipes.title: Hoisin Tofu and Broccoli
recipes.description: Marinated tofu pan-fried golden, then tossed with steamed broccoli in a glossy hoisin sauce.

steps.instructionText: Cut the tofu into 2 cm cubes.
Mix 1/4 cup of the light soy sauce with the dark soy sauce, sugar and rice vinegar. Add the tofu and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In another bowl, stir together the water, remaining light soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil, cornstarch and hoisin sauce.
Cut the broccoli into 1 cm chunks.
Boil 1/3 cup of water in a large pan, add the broccoli, cover and steam for 3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp of the peanut oil in the same pan. Fry the tofu until golden on both sides, then push it to one side.
Add the rest of the peanut oil with the garlic and ginger and stir for 30 seconds, until fragrant.
Pour in the sauce and cook until it thickens, then add the broccoli and toss everything together.

recipes.title: Stuffed Vegetables
recipes.description: Halved tomato, pepper, courgette and aubergine baked under crisp breadcrumbs and Parmesan.

steps.instructionText: Heat the oven to 170 °C (340 °F).
Halve the tomato, pepper, courgette and aubergine lengthways. Scoop a little pulp from the tomato and courgette.
Lay the vegetables on baking paper in a baking tray, cut side up.
Sprinkle with parsley and a little salt, then cover generously with the breadcrumbs and Parmigiano.
Drizzle with enough olive oil to moisten all the breadcrumbs, so they stick and don't burn.
Bake for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Pie
recipes.description: Double-crust pie with a cinnamon apple filling, reduced on the stove before baking.

steps.instructionText: Peel the apples and cut them into 3-5 cm strips.
Mix the apples with the lemon juice, 50 g white sugar, brown sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and cornstarch. Leave for 15 minutes to release their juice.
Tip into a saucepan and reduce the liquid over medium-low heat for 15 minutes, stirring often. Turn off the heat.
Meanwhile, pulse the flour, salt, sugar for the crust and butter in a food processor for 10 seconds, until like coarse sand.
With the motor running, drip in the ice water until the dough clumps and holds together when pinched.
Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Halve the dough and roll each half into a circle big enough for a 23 cm (9 inch) pie dish.
Line the dish with one circle, trim the excess, then spread in the apple filling.
Cover with the second circle, tuck in the edges and press the crusts together with a fork.
Beat the egg with the water and brush it over the top, if using. Cut a few slits in the crust.
Bake for 45 minutes, until the crust is brown and the filling bubbles.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Vareniki
recipes.description: Boiled half-moon dumplings filled with mashed potato, fried onion and mushrooms.

steps.instructionText: Cover the potatoes with salted water and bring to the boil, then simmer for 25 minutes, until tender.
Drain and mash the potatoes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Meanwhile, mix the flour with 1 tsp salt. In another bowl, stir the sour cream and baking soda together.
Mix the water into the flour, then the sour cream mixture, and knead into a smooth dough.
Cover the dough and refrigerate for 15 minutes.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat and fry the onions for 10 minutes, until browned.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, until browned, then mix into the mashed potatoes.
Divide the dough into 4, roll each into a 4 cm thick rope and cut into 1 cm pieces. Press each piece into a small flat circle.
Put 1 tsp of filling in the middle of each circle, fold into a half-moon and seal the edges.
Cook in batches in gently boiling salted water until they float, then 3 minutes more.
Lift out with a slotted spoon and drain.

recipes.title: Bolo do Caco
recipes.description: Madeiran sweet potato flatbreads, slow-fermented for 3 days and cooked in a dry pan.

steps.instructionText: Peel the sweet potatoes, cut them into large pieces and cover with water in a saucepan.
Bring to the boil, cover and cook over medium-high heat for 20 minutes.
Drain, mash and mix in the salt.
Mix the yeast with the warm water and leave for 10 minutes.
Put the flour in a large bowl, make a well and add the mashed sweet potato and yeast.
Knead into a smooth, elastic dough.
Cover and leave the dough to ferment in the fridge for 3 days.
Divide into 10 equal pieces on a floured surface. Shape into balls and flatten to 2.5 cm thick.
Leave to rest somewhere warm and draught-free for 30 minutes.
Cook in a dry pan over medium-high heat, turning often, until a thin crust forms on both sides. Roll them on their edges to cook the sides.
Serve warm with salted butter and parsley.

recipes.title: Scandinavian Coffee Cake
recipes.description: Yeasted cinnamon-sugar ring, sliced and fanned, iced and topped with walnuts.

steps.instructionText: Scald the milk, then stir in the shortening, sugar and salt until the sugar dissolves. Cool to lukewarm.
Dissolve the yeast in the warm water and add it to the milk mixture.
Stir in half the flour, add the eggs and beat well. Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough.
Knead on a lightly floured board until smooth and elastic.
Put in a greased bowl, brush with shortening, cover and leave somewhere warm for 2 hours, until doubled.
Roll out into a 20 x 30 cm rectangle and brush with melted butter.
Sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon, roll up like a Swiss roll and shape into a ring on a greased baking sheet. Pinch the ends together.
Cut from the outside towards the centre, almost all the way through, in 2.5 cm slices. Fan the slices out slightly.
Brush with shortening, cover and leave to rise for 45 minutes, until doubled.
Heat the oven to 190 °C (375 °F).
Bake for 30 minutes.
Spread with the powdered sugar icing while warm and sprinkle with the chopped walnuts.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Sugar Biscuits
recipes.description: Flaky brown-butter biscuits brushed with butter and dipped in cinnamon sugar.

steps.instructionText: Melt 113 g butter in a saucepan over medium heat and swirl until it foams, turns golden brown and smells nutty.
Pour it into a bowl and refrigerate for 45 minutes, until solid and cold.
Whisk the flour, 25 g sugar, baking powder, salt and 1/2 tbsp cinnamon in a large bowl.
Cube the cold browned butter and rub it into the flour until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Pour in the cold milk and stir gently with a fork into a shaggy dough.
Knead 4-5 times on a floured surface, press into a rectangle and fold in thirds like a letter. Turn, press out and repeat the folding 3 more times.
Shape into a 2.5 cm thick square, trim the edges and cut into 9 squares. Shape the scraps into 1 more biscuit.
Heat the oven to 220 °C (425 °F). Set the biscuits close together in a buttered skillet or lined tray.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden on top.
Meanwhile, melt the butter for the glaze and mix the sugar for the glaze with the cinnamon for the glaze.
Brush the hot biscuits with the melted butter and sprinkle at once with the cinnamon sugar. Serve warm.

recipes.title: Sugar-Free Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.description: Soft, chewy peanut butter cookies sweetened with a brown-sugar-style erythritol and stevia blend.

ingredients.name: creamy peanut butter, no sugar added

steps.instructionText: Blend the brown sweetener in a blender until it looks like powdered sugar. Let the dust settle before opening.
Beat the butter with the powdered sweetener using a hand mixer until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the peanut butter, then the egg, egg yolk, cream and vanilla, until smooth and glossy.
Add the flour, baking soda and fine sea salt and mix on low just until no dry streaks remain.
Cover and refrigerate the dough for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Roll the dough into balls of about 1 1/2 tbsp, set them 5 cm apart and press a light crosshatch with a fork.
Bake for 11 minutes, until the edges are set but the centres still look puffy.
Sprinkle at once with the flaky sea salt and leave on the hot sheet for 15 minutes to set.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Cookies
recipes.description: Chewy cinnamon oat cookies, with raisins, cranberries, coconut or nuts if you like.

ingredients.name: raisins, cranberries, coconut or nuts, optional

steps.instructionText: Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F) and line trays with parchment paper.
Whisk the butter, eggs, vanilla and sugar together.
Mix in the flour, cinnamon, salt, oats and any raisins or nuts.
Roll into about 24 golf-ball-sized balls and space them out on the trays.
Bake for 10 minutes, until the edges begin to brown.

recipes.title: Herb and Ricotta Pie
recipes.description: Italian "pizza di erbe": a yeasted double crust filled with chopped greens and ricotta.

steps.instructionText: Dry the boiled greens well and chop them finely.
Mix the greens with the ricotta, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Knead the flour with warm water, a little salt and a little olive oil.
Add the softened butter and the yeast and knead into a soft dough.
Divide the dough in two and roll each half out about 1 cm thick.
Lay one disc on baking paper in a tray and spread the filling over it, leaving a 1.5 cm border.
Cover with the second disc and press the edges together, wetting them with a few drops of water if needed.
Cover with a cloth and leave to rise for 30 minutes.
Prick the top all over with a fork. Heat the oven to 180 °C (350 °F).
Bake for 30 minutes.

recipes.title: Orange Jam
recipes.description: Chunky orange and lemon jam, a Polish topping for mazurek and a bright spread for toast.

steps.instructionText: Zest the oranges and lemon.
Peel off the white pith under the skin.
Blend the fruit briefly, just into small pieces.
Put the blended fruit, zest and sugar in a pot.
Bring to the boil, then boil gently on low heat for 30-40 minutes, until thick but still a little runny.
Let it cool; it thickens further as it cools.
